parts.text: The IGCSE class is investigating the motion of a mass hanging on a spring. Fig. 1.1 shows the apparatus Fig. 1.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) On Fig. 1.1, measure the length l 0 of the unstretched spring, in mm. l 0 = ........................................ mm [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The diagram is drawn one tenth of actual size. Write down the actual length L 0 of the unstretched spring, in mm. L 0 = .........................................mm [1] A student hangs a 300 g mass on the spring and measures the new length L of the spring. 255 mm L = ....................................................

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Calculate the extension e of the spring using the equation e = ( L – L 0 ). e = ..............................................mm

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate a value for the spring constant k using the equation k = F e , where F = 3.0 N. Include the appropriate unit. k = .................................................... [2]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The student adjusts the position of the lower clamp so that the pin is level with the bottom of the mass when the mass is not moving. She pulls the mass down a short distance and releases it so that it oscillates up and down. Fig. 1.2 shows one complete oscillation. Fig. 1.2 She measures the time t taken for 20 complete oscillations. 26.84 s t = .................................................... Calculate the time T taken for one complete oscillation. T = ............................................... [1]
